title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 11 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 11 De S. Theologiae distributione COMPLETE (PHYS 323–330; Liber I ended; Liber II PHYS 331).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 11 On the distribution of sacred theology, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (PHYS 323–330): parts common and proper; Conrad Bergius's five tractation modes (history, prophecy, invocation, exhortation, didascalia); historical and logical methods; ten divisions of theology including Polanus; analytic distribution into common and proper parts; Liber I corona of six requirements for the theology student as theodidaktos. Liber I ENDED PHYS 330. Liber II starts PHYS 331 (De fine hominis / summum bonum). Cap. 2–10 complete; Cap. 1 tip gap still open.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for Liber I Cap. 11 densify complete.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 11 densify COMPLETE, reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS 323–330). Same-page OCR (tesseract lat + Vision) used as check. No modern English was copied. Liber I ended PHYS 330. Liber II (LIBER SECUNDUS / CAPUT PRIMUM De fine hominis … aeterna beatitudine) begins PHYS 331. Cap. 2–10 complete; Cap. 1 tip gap still open. No Internet Archive copy was located.
